modelScope: Only the pinned selected source grammar and named score state. No waveform/PWM/pitch/filter calculation or SID-event generation.

clock.rule: Divider decrements modulo256 and reloads2 on a negative result; remaining decrements only at divider0. Row dispatch requires the decrement result negative. Each low5-bit duration therefore lasts3*(duration+1) play calls.

orders.transposeRule: NonFF high-bit byte sets unsigned transpose=value&7F, advances order cursor and consumes following pattern index. Transpose persists otherwise.
orders.globalFFRule: OrderFF resets ALL3order cursors to0 then rereads current voice order in the same call; no full initialization or sound-state reset.

rows.restRule: C0..DF header consumes no instrument/glide/note payload. Peek following byte forFF end, then gateMask=FE; continuing sound body still executes.
rows.instrumentRule: instrumentOffset=(argument*8)&FF; field persists without the flag.
rows.noteRule: Ordinary note and glide target add retained transpose modulo256.
rows.endRule: FollowingFF sets patternCursor0 and increments this voice order cursor; otherwise cursor points to next header.
rows.byteCursorRule: Pattern/order cursors and consumed Y offsets are bytes.

callableReturns.basis: Actual shared fixed-PAL host JSR return-1 words, validated before each source RTS.
